note: Read 2026-10-30 on the prefecture's own site (the Préfet de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, saint-pierre-et-miquelon.gouv.fr, fetched over HTTP/1.1: its HTTP/2 answered ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM, as wave 13 found it failing). Its licence page sends the applicant to the Agence nationale des titres sécurisés (ANTS), France's national agency, to apply online at permisdeconduire.ants.gouv.fr, with the prefecture's appointment to collect the licence; its page on the kinds of licence speaks of the four types of licence 'en France'; and its page on whether a licence must be redone speaks of the 'permis de conduire européen' and the national licence file (fichier national des permis de conduire). So the licence held there is France's, issued through the prefecture and the ANTS, as Guadeloupe's is (the prefecture's own words, not the territory's status, are the source: Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon is a collectivity under art. 74 of the Constitution, not a department where France's laws apply as of right). The prefecture's tariff sheet (PDF of 31 March 2025) wasn't read: France's own file holds the licence's facts.
